name: Mizuki Charade
source:
A maid with a dynamic personality who is friends with [url=/c105716]Mina[/url] and [url=/c105719]Stella[/url]. Mizuki is a girl who cares deeply about her friends, especially Mina her best friend whom she loves like a sister. She even shows Mina the ropes throughout the work in the mansion. Mizuki keeps a has pet turtle in her room. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040816084928/http://active-soft.jp/catalog/lostmind.html]official website[/url].]
